name: Lorgalis Manuscript
summary: The Lorgalis Manuscript lies hidden beneath Ashenvale in the sunken ruins of Blackfathom Deeps. The ancient text concerns the Old Gods, and dark scholars covet its words about powers that sleep.

sections.title: A Tome of Those Who Sleep
sections.body: The Lorgalis Manuscript lies at the bottom of Blackfathom Deeps, where long-dead elves once lived before their city fell. Lorgalis wrote of the Old Gods, who raged across Azeroth when the world was new and now lie chained and sleeping. The text praises Aku'mai, a servant of the Old Gods who dwells in the Deeps. Its lore is said to open mystical doorways and stir ancient beings sleeping deep beneath the world. The manuscript rests in a pitted iron chest among the flooded corridors, drawing the attention of cultists and shadow scholars alike.

sections.title: Eyes in the Shadows
sections.body: In Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern, the eccentric collector Gerrig Bonegrip hires adventurers to cross the sea and retrieve the text. Bonegrip speaks with reverence of the end days and the awakening of sleeping deities. He intends to have the manuscript transcribed and shared among his shadowy circle of brothers and sisters, spreading forbidden knowledge that surface folk were never meant to understand.

faq.answer: The Lorgalis Manuscript is an old text written by Lorgalis about the Old Gods. Its contents are said to reveal how to open doorways and awaken slumbering primordial beings.
The manuscript rests in a pitted iron chest deep within Blackfathom Deeps, a ruined night elven temple along the Zoram Strand in Ashenvale.
Gerrig Bonegrip, who works from the Forlorn Cavern in Ironforge, wants the manuscript recovered. He plans to copy it and share its teachings with his secretive peers.

faq.q: Why does Gerrig Bonegrip talk about the end days?
faq.answer: Bonegrip reveres and studies the Old Gods. He seeks ancient elven writings about awakening Those Who Sleep, which he believes heralds the coming end times.

angles.text: As a Warlock, the manuscript offers a rare glimpse into forbidden lore about the Old Gods and the entities of the deep, knowledge coveted by those who practice dark arts.
As a night elf, you find the text in drowned ruins where your people once lived. Its reverence for Aku'mai and the Old Gods reveals the dark worship rooted in those fallen halls.
